2021_207_june_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's procurement card (PCARD) transaction register for June 2021, carried on the August 17, 2021 Board of Education agenda as a 17-page listing printed 8/12/2021. Each line is journaled as "JUN PCARD EXP" against a 15-digit budget unit and an account code, with transaction dates running from 5/26/2021 through 6/25/2021 and merchant names truncated to the card-statement descriptor. The register closes with a subtotal of 178,875.28 in charges, 6,647.60 in credits, and Total Expenses of 172,227.68. The largest single charge is 5,780.00 to C & G PUBLIS, posted to budget unit 101928282087400, account 3510.
